verified.claim: Eligible licence classes for a plumbing or mechanical permit are A, B, C4, C16, C20, C36, C54
verified.observed: Contractors must hold a C4, C16, C20, C36, C54, B, or A license to apply for a plumbing or mechanical permit in general.
verified.nuance: The page lists licence TYPES. For B it states approval is scope-based: 'B license, after approval based on the scope of work (plumbing work related to a kitchen or bath permit on PermitSF can be approved immediately for B contractors)'. B-2 is a classification within B, so flag F-08's wording that 'A B-2 licence is not eligible' is broader than the official text. Logged as irregularity I-4.

verified.claim: Only owners of stand-alone single-family dwellings (R-3) may apply to do the work themselves
verified.observed: Only property owners of stand-alone single-family dwellings (R-3 occupancy) may apply for a plumbing or mechanical permit to do the work themselves.
